sentences.text: A many-sorted N categorial algebra has a homogeneous N category for every sort, and interprets every operation symbol as an N functor, defined on the product of the categories of its arity.
So sigma takes a pair of cells, one of sort s and one of sort t, and preserves sources, targets and compositions in every dimension.
For N equal to zero we recover ordinary many-sorted algebras.
A homomorphism between two such algebras is an N functor for every sort, and these functors commute with the operations.
Together, they form the category of N categorial Sigma-algebras.
